title: Hennessy claims Cheney visited S4
summary: UAPGerb tells of Hennessy claims Cheney visited S4, about mid-1990s at S4, Nevada, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: claimed he worked at S4 and sometime in the the mid9s that Dick Cheney came into S4.

plain: A researcher who goes by UAPGerb says that a man named Derek Hennessy claimed to have worked at S4, a site in Nevada. According to UAPGerb, Hennessy said that sometime in the mid-1990s the American politician Dick Cheney came into S4. If true, it would tie a senior political figure to a secret site linked in these stories to unexplained craft.
